reports.proposed_objective: Distinguish defective selectin-ligand fucosylation from integrin activation defects in leukocyte extravasation.

top_matches.tested_construct: A somatic PIGA mutation in a hematopoietic stem cell impairs glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchor biosynthesis, causing loss of GPI-anchored complement regulators such as CD55 and CD59 and thereby permitting complement-mediated intravascular hemolysis and thrombosis.
top_matches.educational_objective: Explain PNH as an acquired somatic PIGA defect causing loss of GPI-anchored CD55/CD59 and complement-mediated intravascular hemolysis.

top_matches.tested_construct: Loss of PTCH1 removes inhibition of Smoothened and constitutively activates Hedgehog signaling, promoting basal cell carcinoma development.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect PTCH1 loss in basal cell nevus syndrome with derepressed Smoothened and Hedgehog signaling.

top_matches.tested_construct: NKX2-5 as a cardiac homeobox transcription factor causing atrial septal defect with progressive atrioventricular conduction disease
top_matches.educational_objective: Associate familial atrial septal defects plus progressive AV conduction disease with NKX2-5, a homeobox transcription factor involved in cardiac development.

reports.proposed_construct: Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome due to defective lysosome-related organelle biogenesis causing absent platelet dense granules and oculocutaneous albinism
reports.proposed_objective: Unify pigment dilution and bleeding through a shared lysosome-related organelle trafficking defect.

top_matches.tested_construct: Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome is a disorder of lysosome-related organelle biogenesis that causes oculocutaneous albinism and a platelet storage-pool defect with absent platelet delta (dense) granules; PT, PTT, and platelet count are typically normal.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome from the combination of albinism, mucocutaneous bleeding, and absent platelet dense bodies.

top_matches.tested_construct: LYST variants disrupt lysosomal trafficking, producing abnormally large lysosomes and related granules in immune and pigment cells, causing recurrent infections, partial oculocutaneous albinism, and bleeding tendency.
top_matches.educational_objective: Link Chediak-Higashi syndrome to defective LYST-dependent lysosomal trafficking.

top_matches.tested_construct: AP3B1 deficiency causes Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome type 2, characterized by oculocutaneous albinism, platelet dense-granule dysfunction/bleeding, neutropenia, and recurrent infections.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize AP3B1-associated HPS2 from the combination of albinism, platelet dense-granule deficiency, neutropenia, and recurrent infection.

top_matches.tested_construct: LYST regulates lysosomal and lysosome-related organelle trafficking, size, and fission. Loss of function produces enlarged fused lysosomal granules in leukocytes and other cells, impairing neutrophil antimicrobial function and cytotoxic-cell degranulation while also disrupting melanosomes and platelet dense granules.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize Chediak-Higashi syndrome from recurrent pyogenic infections, partial albinism, bleeding tendency, and giant leukocyte granules and connect it to defective LYST-mediated lysosomal trafficking.

top_matches.tested_construct: Biallelic NBEAL2 variants impair platelet alpha-granule biogenesis. Platelets are often large, pale or gray on light microscopy, with alpha-granule deficiency and variable thrombocytopenia and bleeding.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize NBEAL2-related gray platelet syndrome from macrothrombocytopenia, gray platelets, and alpha-granule deficiency.

top_matches.tested_construct: SLC25A15 encodes ORNT1, the mitochondrial ornithine transporter that moves cytosolic ornithine into the mitochondrial matrix. Loss deprives the urea cycle of intramitochondrial ornithine, causing hyperammonemia, hyperornithinemia, and homocitrullinuria.
top_matches.educational_objective: Link HHH syndrome to defective mitochondrial ornithine import through SLC25A15/ORNT1.

top_matches.tested_construct: Platelet dense granules contain ADP, serotonin and high concentrations of calcium. After platelet activation, dense-granule ADP is released and amplifies recruitment and aggregation through purinergic platelet receptors, especially P2Y12.
top_matches.educational_objective: Differentiate platelet dense granules from alpha granules and identify ADP as a dense-granule mediator of platelet recruitment and aggregation.

top_matches.tested_construct: CD40 ligand deficiency on activated T cells prevents B-cell class-switch recombination, causing high or normal IgM with very low IgG, IgA, and IgE.
top_matches.educational_objective: Explain hyper-IgM syndrome through defective T-cell help for B-cell class switching.

reports.proposed_construct: Niemann-Pick disease type C due to NPC1 or NPC2 defects in lysosomal cholesterol egress causing intracellular unesterified cholesterol accumulation and vertical supranuclear gaze palsy
reports.proposed_objective: Distinguish defective intracellular cholesterol trafficking from lysosomal sphingomyelin degradation defects.

top_matches.tested_construct: NPC1 or NPC2 defects impair intracellular cholesterol and lipid trafficking from lysosomes, causing progressive neurodegeneration and visceral lipid accumulation.
top_matches.educational_objective: Identify defective lysosomal cholesterol trafficking in Niemann-Pick type C.

top_matches.tested_construct: Loss of NPC1 or NPC2 function disrupts intracellular trafficking of lysosomal lipid cargo, causing accumulation of unesterified cholesterol, glycosphingolipids, and gangliosides within lysosomes and progressive visceral and neurologic disease.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize Niemann-Pick type C and connect its characteristic neurologic-visceral phenotype to NPC1/NPC2-dependent lysosomal lipid-trafficking failure.

top_matches.tested_construct: Acid alpha-glucosidase deficiency prevents lysosomal glycogen degradation, causing glycogen accumulation in heart and skeletal muscle.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize the enzyme defect in Pompe disease.

top_matches.tested_construct: Acid sphingomyelinase deficiency causes sphingomyelin accumulation in macrophages and neurons, leading to hepatosplenomegaly and progressive neurodegeneration.
top_matches.educational_objective: Differentiate Niemann-Pick A from Tay-Sachs clinically.

top_matches.tested_construct: Certain misfolded alpha-1 antitrypsin variants polymerize and accumulate within hepatocyte endoplasmic reticulum, causing toxic gain-of-function liver injury.
top_matches.educational_objective: Distinguish the toxic protein-accumulation mechanism of alpha-1 antitrypsin liver disease from the loss-of-antiprotease mechanism causing emphysema.

top_matches.tested_construct: SEC23B is a component of the COPII coat that mediates export of newly synthesized proteins from the endoplasmic reticulum toward the Golgi. Biallelic SEC23B defects impair erythroid maturation and protein trafficking/processing, causing congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II with ineffective erythropoiesis and characteristic binucleated erythroblasts.
top_matches.educational_objective: Link SEC23B-related congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II to defective COPII-mediated ER-to-Golgi protein transport.

top_matches.tested_construct: The Z alpha-1 antitrypsin variant misfolds and polymerizes within hepatocyte endoplasmic reticulum, causing toxic intracellular accumulation and liver disease. Reduced secretion simultaneously lowers circulating AAT, permitting neutrophil-elastase-mediated alveolar destruction in the lung.
top_matches.educational_objective: Distinguish the hepatic gain-of-function mechanism of PI*ZZ alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency—ER polymer accumulation—from the pulmonary loss-of-function mechanism.

top_matches.tested_construct: Arylsulfatase A deficiency impairs lysosomal degradation of sulfatides, causing sulfatide accumulation in the central and peripheral nervous systems with progressive demyelination and neurodegeneration.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect arylsulfatase A deficiency with lysosomal sulfatide accumulation in metachromatic leukodystrophy.

reports.proposed_construct: Congenital disorder of glycosylation from phosphomannomutase 2 deficiency, reducing mannose-1-phosphate and GDP-mannose synthesis for N-linked glycosylation
reports.proposed_objective: Connect PMM2 deficiency to deficient glycoprotein assembly and multisystem disease.

top_matches.tested_construct: PMM2 encodes phosphomannomutase 2, which converts mannose-6-phosphate to mannose-1-phosphate. Loss of PMM2 lowers the mannose-1-phosphate/GDP-mannose pool and impairs synthesis of lipid-linked oligosaccharides required for N-linked protein glycosylation.
top_matches.educational_objective: Link PMM2-CDG to impaired conversion of mannose-6-phosphate to mannose-1-phosphate and deficient N-linked glycosylation.

top_matches.tested_construct: Biotinidase deficiency prevents efficient recycling of biotin, reducing activity of multiple biotin-dependent carboxylases and causing neurologic and cutaneous disease.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect biotinidase deficiency with impaired carboxylase function.

top_matches.tested_construct: Danon disease is an X-linked LAMP2-related multisystem disorder in which males commonly develop severe childhood-onset hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and conduction abnormalities together with skeletal myopathy and mild intellectual disability.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize Danon disease from early hypertrophic cardiomyopathy/conduction disease plus skeletal myopathy and cognitive involvement in an X-linked pattern.

top_matches.tested_construct: Defects in thyroid-hormone synthesis enzymes such as thyroid peroxidase impair iodination of thyroglobulin, reducing thyroid hormone production and risking abnormal growth and neurodevelopment.
top_matches.educational_objective: Link TPO deficiency to impaired iodination and congenital thyroid-hormone deficiency.

top_matches.tested_construct: PHEX loss of function increases FGF23 activity. Excess FGF23 reduces proximal-tubular phosphate reabsorption by promoting internalization of sodium-phosphate cotransporters and also lowers calcitriol synthesis, producing chronic phosphate wasting and defective bone mineralization.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect PHEX deficiency with excess FGF23 and proximal-tubular sodium-phosphate cotransporter internalization in X-linked hypophosphatemia.

top_matches.tested_construct: Pathogenic variants in the X-linked GLA gene reduce lysosomal alpha-galactosidase A activity. Inadequate degradation of globotriaosylceramide and related glycosphingolipids causes progressive lysosomal accumulation in vascular, renal, cardiac, and neural tissues.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize Fabry disease from its characteristic early phenotype and connect it to X-linked GLA deficiency and lysosomal globotriaosylceramide accumulation.

top_matches.tested_construct: Biallelic DHCR7 deficiency impairs the final step of cholesterol synthesis, reducing cholesterol and increasing 7-dehydrocholesterol, which disrupts embryonic development and multiple organ systems.
top_matches.educational_objective: Link low cholesterol plus congenital anomalies to DHCR7 deficiency in the final cholesterol-synthesis step.

top_matches.tested_construct: Isoniazid metabolites interfere with vitamin B6 metabolism, reducing biologically active pyridoxal phosphate and predisposing to peripheral neuropathy; pyridoxine supplementation prevents or treats this toxicity.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect isoniazid-associated peripheral neuropathy with functional vitamin B6 deficiency and pyridoxine supplementation.
